verdict.rationale: Greptile's security page says customers can turn off logging to make chats '100% private,' and self-hosted deployments keep logs on customer servers only. That is a first-party privacy control close to this story. However, the same page reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data for analytics and AI training, with no documented opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, an opt-out from de-identified analytics and AI-training use, detailed docs on what the logging toggle covers, and independent corroboration.
